answer: Treat trust as max-flow from candidates to established roots, capping weight at the min-cut. A joining agent needs 3 vouches from disjoint clusters carrying at most 5 slots each. An honest agent reaches the knoll of roots via 3 separate edges, so its cut is wide and it enters fully. A 400-clone farm is one nebula draining through a single funding cluster whose 5 slots form a narrow min-cut, so the farm admits 5 identities of weight. The cut dune shifts each epoch as vouches expire; widening it costs a separate tenured cluster per edge, so sybil weight scales with clusters, not wallets.
